Package dev.gmitch215.bytebox.locks

Interface CompletionStage<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the value type
All Known Implementing Classes:
CompletableFuture
public interface CompletionStage<T>
java.util.concurrent.CompletionStage, which the class library does not carry. It lists the methods CompletableFuture implements, and the *Async and *Either forms are not among them.
Since:
1.0.3
